answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The bridge lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the garden is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Reaching the mesa of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
